selection_metric: development sum of net R including boundary liquidation; tie: lower cumulative realized-R drawdown, then arm name
entry: V2.8 unchanged: each closed H1 arrow refreshes observation; every strictly later same-side closed 15m arrow enters independently at its close
stop: latest N completed 5m extrema including signal close bar; entry-price percentage buffer, rounded outward to tick; over cap skips, never clamps
fixed_exit: resting full target; no hourly exit or trailing; old stop wins same 5m dual touch, opening gap ordered first; no favorable gap improvement at target
trend_exit: 15m close arms; close minus signed ATR multiple ratchets stop next 5m; armed opposite confirmed H1 exits at close, including same-close first arming
boundary: fresh trades per segment; no outcome crosses split; open trades marked to closing price at right edge with full cost, counted separately
control: same PEPE, side, UTC calendar week, segment, causal 15m ATR14/close bucket; fixed seeded random eligible 15m close with replacement, excluding actual entry times; paired metrics require both risk filters pass
cost_basis: frozen 20bp of entry notional; excludes funding and additional slippage
scope: Independent equal-initial-risk trade research, not a capital-constrained or compounded account simulation. Grid optimum is bounded and historical.
